feeds.title: Carey Nieuwhof Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Carey Nieuwhof, and I'm committed to help you lead like never before. From here you can access some of today's best leadership resources free. Carey blogs, podcasts, writes and speaks to church leaders around the world about leadership, change and personal growth.

feeds.title: ReKnew
feeds.description: ReKnew aims to offer fresh and relevant content that is smart, challenging, and accessible. Our heart is to educate, inspire, and expand the growing movement of Jesus followers by helping them know again the God they thought they knew.

feeds.title: Discerning Dad
feeds.description: My hope is that all who visit will be encouraged in the hope we have in Jesus and challenged to align their views with that of the Bible. My goal is to build a community of discerning leaders and various perspectives to help all grow in their walk with the Lord.

feeds.title: Gene S. Whitehead Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Gene and I write about the world we live in and the experience of life through the lens of scripture. Another way to say that is simple theology for a messy life. And by simple, I don't mean easy!

feeds.title: David's Coffee Stains
feeds.description: David Porter is an American who has lived and worked in Europe, first in Luxembourg then in France, for most of the last 34 years. He's passionate about helping Christians grow and helping them to smile while they are at it.

feeds.title: What's Happening At AWM Blog
feeds.description: Andrew created this site as a way of keeping his friends and partners up to date on ministry news and activities. You will find articles, videos, and photos posted here about meetings we've held, trips overseas, ministry expansion projects, Charis Bible College, and much more.

feeds.title: Man in the Mirror Blog
feeds.description: The blog has a collection of articles to take Christian men beyond 'men's ministry' and into discipleship relationships that transform men, their families, their communities, and the world. Man in the Mirror is working with churches and millions of men to see every man reflect honestly, pursue God wholeheartedly, and live vibrantly. The mission of Man in the Mirror is to equip Christian men around the world to engage in meaningful relationships that change lives and build the kingdom of God.

feeds.title: Christianity and masculinity
feeds.description: I am a Christian man on his mission, which includes a search for a godly wife. This blog is written for men. The focus is to accurately pursue the Truth of how God created man and woman in conjunction with obedience to the Scriptures.

feeds.title: Manhood Journey Blog
feeds.description: A Christian blog for Dads built around key concepts & truths from the Bible. Covers articles on Communication, Faith, Leadership, Marriage, Overcoming Failure, and Training. Manhood Journey helps dads become disciple-makers.

feeds.title: Walking With A Limp
feeds.description: I am a 38-year-old husband, father, writer & blogger, musician, and seminary graduate. Prior to pursuing vocational ministry, I worked for 15 years with people with disabilities. I blog about faith, family, life. My writing interests are in exploring new ways to articulate the timeless truths of our faith in an ever-changing world. I love to find inspiration in biblical stories or passages that are often forgotten or are not often the subjects for sermons.

feeds.title: Christian Men's Network
feeds.description: Highly effective global movement of pastors and leaders dedicated to training men toward their roles as servant-leaders in their families, church, and culture.

feeds.title: Elihu's Corner
feeds.description: Elihu is a hebrew name that means 'My God is He.' I am a follower of Christ and I write these things to proclaim God's power and majesty. What I share here on this humble corner of the web is what I have learned and discovered. May the reader be edified and uplifted.

feeds.title: Karlo Broussard » Articles
feeds.description: My name is Karlo Broussard, I am a Catholic Apologist and Speaker. I would love to speak at your event and set the hearts of the Catholic faithful in your area on fire with an unbelievable passion and zeal to evangelize others with the truth of the Catholic Faith.
